Il DPP di Taiwan, che governa a livello locale, si aggiunge considerevolmente alle elezioni locali, ma l'opposizione KMT può difendere la capitale. (Frankfurter Allgemeine, tradotto)

Il Kuomintang (KMT), il partito più antico di Taiwan, favorendo legami più stretti con la Cina, ha mantenuto il municipio della capitale Taipei, una vittoria simbolica la sera delle elezioni locali che si sono svolte nell'isola rivendicata dal governo. (RFI, tradotto)

Al Jazeera: Gli elettori di tutta Taiwan hanno votato per sindaci, membri del consiglio e altri leader locali.

stories.headline: Pleiotropy promotes divergence when simulating the development and evolution of two interacting organs
stories.dek: Pleiotropy, which can occur when a gene affects multiple traits, is a central property of living organisms, influencing their response to mutations and their evolutionary trajectories.
stories.summary: Despite many studies and discussions, it remains very difficult to reconcile molecular, developmental and quantitative evolutionary genetics viewpoints on pleiotropy and appreciate how much it puts constraints on genetic evolution, phenotypic evolution and adaptation. Here, we revisit this question by simulating evolution in silico. (bioRxiv)

stories.headline: Exploring the roles of temperature and competition in Fennoscandic Holocene plant communities using dynamic sedimentary ancient DNA models
stories.dek: Ecosystems are constantly responding to shifting environmental conditions, and the observed structure of ecological communities at any given discrete observation timepoint is part of a larger dynamic response.
stories.summary: However, we lack long-term time series of ecosystem responses allowing understanding of the processes driving community dynamics. Sedimentary ancient DNA (sedaDNA) offers novel opportunities to link empirical data with ecological processes, providing near continuous records of plant and animal community changes over millennia. (bioRxiv)

stories.headline: Who Fills the Gap? Role Similarity and Teammates' Minutes When NBA Players Are Ruled Out
stories.dek: When a core player is ruled out before an NBA game, do teammates whose statistical role resembles that of the removed set (every rotation player ruled out, about three per case) play more?
stories.summary: Using injury reports stamped at least six hours before tip-off and rosters reconstructed after the season, we study 2,441 team-games from 2023-24 to 2025-26 in which a core player was ruled out for a medical reason. (arXiv)
